vb_textbox.text: The first half of the experiment, i chose Blue over red, Orange over green and pink over purple, i also choose yellow over brown which seemed to score a lot of points everytime i got a yellow gnome. The second half of the experiment was a little more difficult to gauge i tried the original choices but they began rewarding less points so i reversed the choices, Red over blue, green over orange, purple over pink and brown over yellow and this then seemed to start scoring more points too
